'''Princess Sara''' (Japanese: '''セーラ姫''' ''Princess Sarah'') is the Princess of the [[Mirage Kingdom]]. She appeared in ''[[AG044|The Princess and the Togepi]]'' and ''[[AG045|A Togepi Mirage!]]''.

After noticing {{TRT}}'s blimp landing, she found [[Misty's Togepi]] injured in the fountain at the palace garden. Sara's parents, the [[King and Queen of the Mirage Kingdom]], and the caretaker, {{ho|Miranda}}, thought the Togepi belonged to Sara, so when {{an|Misty}} arrived, they assumed she was a thief. Misty explained about [[Colonel Hansen]], and Sara gave Togepi back.

After Togepi was stolen again by Hansen, and after Hansen sent Sara's parents to the dungeon, Ash and company helped her stop Hansen. She vowed never to let an impure-hearted person rule the Mirage Kingdom, because if the kingdom was ruled by someone with an impure heart, this would destroy the [[Togepi Paradise]]. After Hansen got arrested, one of the Togepi from the Togepi Paradise decides to join her, and she becomes eligible to be the ruler of the Kingdom.
